faq.title: Cannabis FAQ for Washington, DC | Torch Cannabis Delivery
faq.description: Answers about Torch hours, delivery times, ID, delivery fees, deals and DC cannabis law. Cannabis delivery across DC, Maryland and Virginia.
faq.body:
GOOD TO KNOW

Cannabis FAQ for DC

Hours, ID, payment, deals and the law, in one place.

Questions and answers

What are your hours?

We're open 7 days a week, 7AM to 11PM, for delivery and curbside pickup. We take orders until 11PM.

How fast is delivery?

Most orders arrive in 30 to 90 minutes after your ID is verified, depending on traffic.

How does ID verification work?

After you order, text us a photo of your ID and a quick selfie. You must be 21 or older.

Do you deliver to hotels?

Yes. Torch delivers to hotels in DC, Maryland and Virginia. See our hotel delivery guide.

Can I order late at night?

Yes. We take orders every night until 11PM. See our late-night delivery details.

Which neighborhoods do you deliver to?

All of Washington, DC, plus Maryland and Virginia up to 25 miles from DC. DC neighborhoods include Downtown, Adams Morgan, Columbia Heights, Brookland, Shaw, Logan Circle, Capitol Hill, Navy Yard, Dupont Circle, Petworth, U Street, Georgetown, H Street, Penn Quarter, Woodley Park, Foggy Bottom, NoMa, Anacostia, Congress Heights, Hillcrest, Fairlawn, Friendship Heights, The Wharf, Mount Pleasant, Cleveland Park, Takoma, Chinatown, Kalorama, Tenleytown, Glover Park, Eckington, Trinidad, Brightwood, Bloomingdale, Mount Vernon Triangle, Union Market, Van Ness, Chevy Chase, Shepherd Park, Deanwood, Buzzard Point, Palisades, Hill East, Eastern Market, Barracks Row, West End and Ivy City. In Maryland we deliver to Bethesda, Silver Spring, Takoma Park, Hyattsville, College Park, National Harbor, Oxon Hill, Largo, Wheaton, Greenbelt, Rockville, Bowie, Gaithersburg, North Bethesda, Chevy Chase, MD, Kensington, Laurel, Capitol Heights and Fort Washington, and in Virginia to Arlington, Alexandria, Tysons, Vienna, Falls Church, Annandale, Springfield, Fairfax, Woodbridge, Reston, Herndon, Crystal City, Pentagon City, Rosslyn, Clarendon, Ballston, Old Town Alexandria, McLean, Shirlington, Merrifield, Bailey's Crossroads and Burke.

Do you deliver to Maryland and Virginia?

Yes. Torch delivers to Maryland and Virginia up to 25 miles from DC. Delivery is $20 inside the Beltway or within 2 miles outside it, and $40 farther out. More than 25 miles away? Call or text (202) 468-1966 before ordering.

Where are you located?

Torch is a Downtown DC cannabis dispensary offering delivery across DC, Maryland and Virginia, plus curbside pickup. No walk-ins: order online or call (202) 468-1966.

How do I pay?

Cash on delivery. Our drivers don't carry change, so please have exact cash ready.

Is delivery free?

Delivery is free anywhere in DC. In Maryland and Virginia, it's $20 inside the Beltway or within 2 miles outside it, and $40 farther out.

How old do I need to be?

You must be 21 or older with a valid government-issued photo ID, verified by text before your order is confirmed.

Can visitors from out of state order?

Yes. Adults 21+ with a valid government-issued photo ID from any state can order.

How much weed can you have in DC?

Adults 21+ can have up to 2 ounces of weed in DC.

Is weed legal in DC?

Adults 21 and older can have up to 2 ounces of weed in DC. Using it in public and driving after using it are not allowed.

Where can I buy weed in DC?

Order from Torch, a Downtown DC cannabis dispensary. Shop weed online for same-day delivery across DC, Maryland and Virginia, or curbside pickup.

How do I get weed delivered in DC?

Order online or call (202) 468-1966, text us a photo of your ID and a quick selfie, then meet your driver outside and pay cash. Most orders arrive in 30 to 90 minutes.

What products do you carry?

Flower in three tiers (Midshelf, Topshelf and Exotic), pre-rolls, THC disposables, cartridges, concentrates and edibles.

How do the flower tiers work?

Midshelf is quality flower priced for everyday value, Topshelf is our core lineup of trusted classics and Exotic is rare, small-batch strains for connoisseurs.

Is there a first-order discount?

First orders usually come with a free pre-roll or two, depending on availability. Text us at (202) 468-1966 to ask.

How do the deals work?

The Bundle Deal, Stack & Save and the Half-Pound Haul apply automatically in your cart when you add matching flower. Wake & Bake runs 9AM to 12PM.

Is pickup available?

Curbside pickup is paused right now. Delivery is free in DC and from $20 in Maryland and Virginia.

Is my order discreet?

Yes. Orders are packed in unmarked bags.

Today we deliver across DC, Maryland and Virginia from our location at 1000 G St NW, seven days a week from 7AM to 11PM, with free delivery anywhere in DC.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions | Torch
terms.description: Terms for ordering from Torch: 21+ only, cash on delivery, delivery within Washington, DC, deals and responsible use.
terms.body:
Terms and Conditions

Last updated October 2026

Who can use Torch

You must be 21 or older to use this site or place an order. A valid government-issued photo ID is verified by text before your order is confirmed, and orders are not confirmed without one.

Orders and payment

Orders are paid in cash when they are delivered or picked up. Prices and availability can change, and we may cancel an order if an item is out of stock or the order cannot be verified.

Delivery

We deliver in Washington, DC, and in Maryland and Virginia up to 25 miles from DC. Delivery is free in DC. In Maryland and Virginia it is $20 inside the Beltway or within 2 miles outside it, and $40 farther out. The adult receiving the order must be 21+ and show ID. We may refuse delivery if the recipient appears intoxicated or cannot show valid ID.

Deals

Deals apply as described on the Deals page and may change or end at any time. Wake & Bake is limited to 1 per customer per day.

Responsible use

Do not drive or operate machinery after using cannabis. Keep products away from children and pets. Do not take cannabis across state lines.

Contact

Questions about these terms: info@torchdc.co or (202) 468-1966.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Torch
privacy.description: How Torch collects and uses your name, phone and address to fill orders in Washington, DC. We never sell your information.
privacy.body:
Privacy Policy

Last updated October 2026

What we collect

When you place an order we collect your name, phone number, delivery address and email. We use it only to fill your order, text you updates and answer questions.

What we don't do

We don't sell your information. We share it only with the systems we use to run orders, such as our store software.

Cookies

We store your cart and your age confirmation in your browser so they're there when you come back. You can clear them at any time in your browser settings.

Your choices

Ask us to see, correct or delete your information at info@torchdc.co.
